Streets, schools and getting around Cliff Drive

items.t: Where the condo stock concentrates: nowhere in this pocket, on the sources checked — the stock confirmed on official sources is freehold single detached houses under the RS zones and duplex product under the RD zones where those zones apply, and no condo or townhome complex name with a street address in Cliff Drive is confirmed on an official, developer, strata or manager source. See.

Market numbers: none exist for this sub-area in the sources used. South Delta (Ladner / Tsawwassen) is not in SnapStats coverage — its Delta coverage is North Delta only, and North Delta numbers must never be presented as Cliff Drive or Tsawwassen numbers; the SnapStats FVR September 2026 report contains no Tsawwassen section and no Cliff Drive row.

Recreation anchors: Brandrith Park, 5093 12 Ave (pickleball, picnic tables, sport courts, sports fields, tennis courts, washrooms, per the City park search); South Delta Recreation Centre, 1720 56 St; Tsawwassen Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library), 1321A 56 St, at Tsawwassen Town Centre.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Cliff Drive

items.t: Delta zoning — number contested, flagged as required: City of Delta pages cite Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, 2017, while an internal title says "8400, 2025" — the collision is flagged here and neither number is asserted as settled. On the City pages as cited, Tsawwassen lots sit under the RS and RD zones assigned parcel by parcel, with subdivision minimums including RS4 at 610 m², RS5 at 550 m² (or 460 m² outside the Single Family Residential designation), RS6 at 390 m², RS7 at 335 m², RD1 at 836 m² and RD4 at 504 m², while RS1, RS2, RS3, RD2 and RD3 sit at 4,000 m².

Hazard Development Permit Area SD2: the OCP's hazard DPAs in Tsawwassen include SD2 English Bluff (Tsawwassen Escarpment), immediately west of this pocket. Which specific Cliff Drive parcels fall inside SD2: Not verified — it is read parcel by parcel off the OCP DPA maps.

PTT: 1% on the first $200,000, 2% from $200,000 to $2 million, 3% above $2 million, plus a further 2% on the residential portion above $3 million. Newly Built Home Exemption: full to $1,100,000, gone at $1,150,000.

blocks.text: Good to know about Cliff Drive

items.t: The sub-area name is used in listings for a wider area than the pocket itself.

There is no separate Tsawwassen Area Plan to consult for this pocket: the current consolidated OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), has a single Land Use Plan. City reports and listings that predate July 2024 may refer to the earlier area plans; read them against the current OCP.
Brandrith Park is the pocket's park, at 5093 12 Ave — listed by the City with pickleball, picnic tables, sport courts, sports fields, tennis courts and washrooms.

The escarpment permit area starts at the pocket's western edge. SD2 English Bluff (Tsawwassen Escarpment) is a hazard Development Permit Area under the OCP — a diligence item for the English Bluff Road side that listing copy does not flag.

items.t: Delta OCP: Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), "Housing Our Future," adopted July 8, 2024 — a single consolidated plan with no separate Tsawwassen Area Plan; farm land is designated "Agriculture (A)."

Flood frame: the City of Delta is the diking authority and operates over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure.

PTT + exemptions, with the tier flag: general PTT is 1% on the first $200,000, 2% from $200,000 to $2,000,000 and 3% above $2,000,000, plus a further 2% on the residential portion above $3,000,000 — a page row reading "Over $3M — 5%" is a compression of that 3% + 2%, not a separate rate, and worked examples must show the tier math. First-time buyers: exempt on the first $500,000 at fair market value $835,000 or less, partial to $860,000. Newly built home exemption: full to $1,100,000, eliminated at $1,150,000.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Cliff Drive
What trades here

items.t: Fee-simple lots are the only land form: typical stock is single detached houses under the RS zones around 12 Avenue and English Bluff Road, with duplex product under the RD zones where those zones apply; zoning is assigned parcel by parcel on the City zoning maps. A Cliff Drive parcel is bought whole (house, lot and zone), not as a serviced lot in a subdivision product.

Lot sizes: the subdivision minimums that frame new lots are RS4 at 610 m², RS5 at 550 m² (or 460 m² outside the Single Family Residential designation), RS6 at 390 m², RS7 at 335 m², RD1 at 836 m² and RD4 at 504 m², while RS1, RS2, RS3, RD2 and RD3 sit at 4,000 m². Existing lot sizes vary and are confirmed parcel by parcel; no typical or average lot size is published.

Named subdivisions / bare-land developments: none verified — count 0: Assemblies, development sites and proposals, where a seller promotes one, are documented as such, never as inventory — none is documented for this pocket.

Bare-land strata: none verified — count 0: The stock confirmed on official sources is freehold houses and duplexes; any strata product in the narrow pocket is not verified. The Garden Place NWS1841 units are built strata, not bare-land strata, and sit outside the pocket as defined — see the OPEN flag at the top.
: No presale lot offering in Cliff Drive is documented.
ALR vs non-ALR split: A specific parcel's ALR status is checked in the ALC's ALR Property and Map Finder and on title.

Hazard edge: the OCP's hazard Development Permit Areas in Tsawwassen include SD2 English Bluff (Tsawwassen Escarpment), immediately west of this pocket. Which specific Cliff Drive parcels fall inside SD2: Not verified — read parcel by parcel off the OCP DPA maps before pricing any western-edge lot.

Servicing: Parcel-level servicing and connection charges: Not confirmed. The City is the diking authority and operates over 63 km of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 km of drainage infrastructure.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Cliff Drive

items.t: Municipality: City of Delta, BC. Cliff Drive sits inside the Tsawwassen community — one of Delta's three communities (Ladner, Tsawwassen and North Delta), with Ladner and Tsawwassen together called South Delta — planned under the Delta Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024).

The wider-definition question, stated once and left OPEN: secondary listing sources label units at 1440 / 1441 Garden Place ("The Camelia" / "Magnolia", strata plan NWS1841, built 1982) with the subdivision name Cliff Drive; those addresses sit by the town-centre / Winskill side of Tsawwassen, outside the narrow pocket above, and sources disagree on the assignment.

Schools are SD37 and address-based, K–7 elementary and 8–12 secondary with no middle-school tier. The recorded sample result for 1299 56 St — at the pocket's eastern edge, not binding the whole pocket — is Cliff Drive Elementary, 5025 12 Ave, and South Delta Secondary, 750 53 St. Catchments for other addresses: Not verified — run the exact address in the SD37 School Locator. Ministry-listed names only are used here: Cliff Drive Elementary; South Delta Secondary.

Anchors: Brandrith Park, 5093 12 Ave (pickleball, picnic tables, sport courts, sports fields, tennis courts, washrooms); South Delta Recreation Centre, 1720 56 St; Tsawwassen Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library), 1321A 56 St. Transit: route 601 South Delta / Boundary Bay to Bridgeport Station via 56 Street and South Delta Exchange (56 Street and 18 Avenue); route 602 Tsawwassen Heights to Bridgeport Station via the exchange. Driving times in minutes: Not verified.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Cliff Drive

items.t: OCP: Delta Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), "Housing Our Future", adopted July 8, 2024 — a single consolidated plan with no separate Tsawwassen Area Plan. Farm land in the plan is designated "Agriculture (A)".

Strata block — stated for completeness, governing no verified Cliff Drive land stock: if a bare-land strata lot were ever the purchase (none is verified here), the BC block would apply to the LOT — Form B (Strata Property Act s. 59) within 7 days, max $35 plus up to 25¢/page, with fees, CRF balance, levies, insurance summary, rules, budget and depreciation report; depreciation reports every five years for stratas with five or more lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws void since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2 + Reg 7.01, May 1, 2023 exemptions); a "45+" listing line is not a valid age bylaw.

Market context: none stated — South Delta / Tsawwassen is not SnapStats-covered, North Delta figures are never substituted, and SnapStats has no land category (Detached vs "Condos & Townhomes" combined only) in any case.

blocks.text: Good to know about Cliff Drive

items.t: The name itself is the first trap.

The anchor school sits inside the pocket; the sample catchment sits at its edge. Cliff Drive Elementary is physically at 5025 12 Ave, but the only recorded locator sample is 1299 56 St at the eastern edge — do not market a western-edge lot as "in the Cliff Drive Elementary catchment" without its own locator run.

The escarpment is immediately west, not inside the sales pitch. SD2 English Bluff (Tsawwassen Escarpment) is the OCP's hazard DPA for the shore west of this pocket; which Cliff Drive parcels fall inside it is a map read, not a neighbourhood assumption.
Cliff Drive is a sub-area name with no official boundary.
